description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakePreferences component, testing functions such as sanitizing trigger words, display string formatting, and load/save operations to UserDefaults.

classes.name: VoiceWakePreferencesTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the VoiceWakePreferences utility, verifying correct behavior of sanitization, defaults, display formatting, and persistence.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsTrimsAndDropsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that trigger words are trimmed and empty strings are dropped.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsFallsBackToDefaultsWhenEmpty
methods.description: Tests fallback to default trigger words when input is empty or whitespace only.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordLength
methods.description: Ensures trigger words are limited to a maximum allowed length.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWordsLimitsWordCount
methods.description: Ensures the number of trigger words does not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: displayStringUsesSanitizedWords
methods.description: Verifies the display string correctly converts sanitized trigger words into a comma-separated list.

methods.name: loadAndSaveTriggerWordsRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests that loading and saving trigger words to UserDefaults maintains data integrity.
